title: The Coat That Cost Nothing
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：style　|　正文 373 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 style 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My aunt was the best-dressed woman in a street where nobody had any money, and she achieved it by not buying anything. Her ① style was subtraction: one good coat, worn for eleven years, and nothing else that anyone would notice. Style, she said once, costs nothing and takes years. She said ② style is what is left after you have stopped trying, which I thought was nonsense at fifteen and think is nearly true now.

She made her own clothes. The ③ style she worked in was borrowed from a photograph of her mother taken in 1961 — a narrow collar, a high pocket, a hem that stopped exactly at the knee — and she copied it for thirty years without changing a button. Fashion, she pointed out, is what other people are wearing; a ④ style is what you go on wearing when they have stopped.

I asked her once how one learns it. 'Badly,' she said, 'and in public.' My own ⑤ style at seventeen was a ⑥ style borrowed whole from a magazine: three sizes too large, entirely wrong for the weather, and gone by March. What she did, which I could not do, was ⑦ style the same coat four different ways — collar up, collar down, belt, no belt — and make each of them look deliberate.

Her clothes were not ⑧ in style and never had been; they were made to be worn, not admired. What they were was ⑨ out of style in a way that made other people uneasy, because it implied a standard and a standard is an argument. She wore that coat to two weddings, one funeral, and every interview she ever had, and she got every job.

She died in 2019 and left me the coat. It does not fit, and I have never had the nerve to alter it. She also left three letters, written in a ⑩ style that had gone out with fountain pens: long sentences, no hurry, and not one of them about clothes. Style, I have decided after eleven years of failing at it, is mostly a form of stubbornness: the willingness to wear the same thing long enough that it stops being a costume and becomes a person. I am still working on the length.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 风格；作风；格调
B. n. 款式；式样；设计
C. n. 时尚；流行样式（fashion 同义）
D. n. 举止；风度；做派
E. v. 设计；把……做成某种式样（style sth）
F. 固定搭配：in style 时髦；合乎时尚
G. 固定搭配：out of style 过时；不再流行
H. n. （写作、艺术的）文体；表现手法

items.q: She said style is what is left
a style is what you go on wearing
was a style borrowed whole from a magazine
was style the same coat four different ways
Her clothes were not in style
out of style in a way that made other people uneasy
written in a style that had gone out with fountain pens

answers.why: 指她的整体“风格、作风”，即做减法：一件好外套穿十一年。
此处 style 指一个人的“风度、做派”，说不再刻意之后剩下的那点东西。
指具体的“款式、式样”，后文逐一描述：窄领、高口袋、及膝下摆。
与 fashion 对举，指个人持续的“风格”，别人不穿了你还穿。
指“我”十七岁时的“风格”，与她的做法相对。
指从杂志上整个搬来的“流行样式”，故三个号太大、不合天时。
style 作动词，意为“设计、把……做出某种式样”，指同一件外套做出四种穿法。
in style 意为“时髦、合乎时尚”，说她的衣服从来不时髦。
out of style 意为“过时、不再流行”，说这种老派做派让别人不自在。
指写作的“文体、文风”，说她信里的句式属于另一个时代。
